protocol.basis: Matched upright 720 x 480 H.264, 52 native pictures at 24 fps, fixed earlier-copy luminance operating point.
protocol.cohorts: Two consumed CREMA-D pairs of interest and eight prior-extent-disjoint CREMA-D sources with frozen public bytes. The eight had exposure in other project studies. No source chosen using a response from this method.
protocol.operations: Three local edits per held source. Large and small local grade with known boxes and half-open interval. Texture edit with same-clock horizontal pixel copy inside a separate box and tapered sides. Ordinary controls are strong recompression, a full-clip affine grade, and wrong source. No generator used.
protocol.arms: Baseline quantile normalization and component; bounded component alone; corresponding-pixel robust affine fit alone; and both. No change to clocks, time selector, or public confidence.
protocol.advancement: At least 7/8 large edits, 7/8 small, and 5/8 local texture by 0.5 time and 0.1 pixel IoU. At least two net locations or 0.10 improved median spatial IoU on one edit type, at most one lost location overall. At most one added false neutral flag and zero admitted wrong sources. Show source-pair counts and distinguish time from crop.
